snippet.title: Eki - The Station - All 5 Endings | Full Game [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
You need to get back home, but you lost the only train for home... Getting home has never been this hard...

Eki - The Station is a retro-styled japanese inspired game about a person trying to get back home late in the night.

My opinion:
I normally don't post videos smaller than 8 minutes, but there's a lot of endings on this one, so I don't see a reason as to why not post it. Honestly? I really love these type of games: Short, but full of content.

I say this since the endings vary a lot between each other, instead of being something similar to the next one. I wasn't a big fan of the 'loud means scary' though.

Play Eki - The Station ► https://maatingamedev.itch.io/ekithestation
